title: The Cure · Lullaby
description: The complete supplied bedroom nightmare: iron bed, striped pyjamas, white pillows and red blanket, window hands, cobwebs, wall figure and giant spider, swallowing imagery and a web-covered band. Original music with physical mouth-engine vocals.

characters.name: Robert · the physical singer
characters.role: One source-timed physical voice shared by the bed, wall and trapped figure

cues.speaker: lullaby-robert
cues.text: On candy-striped legs the spiderman comes

cues.speaker: lullaby-robert
cues.text: Softly through the shadow of the evening sun

cues.speaker: lullaby-robert
cues.text: Stealing past the windows of the blissfully dead

cues.speaker: lullaby-robert
cues.text: Looking for the victim shivering in bed

cues.speaker: lullaby-robert
cues.text: Searching out fear in the gathering gloom

cues.speaker: lullaby-robert
cues.text: And suddenly a movement in the corner of the room

cues.speaker: lullaby-robert
cues.text: And there is nothing I can do

cues.speaker: lullaby-robert
cues.text: When I realize with fright

cues.speaker: lullaby-robert
cues.text: That the spiderman is having me for dinner tonight

cues.speaker: lullaby-robert
cues.text: Quietly he laughs and shaking his head

cues.speaker: lullaby-robert
cues.text: Creeps closer now closer to the foot of the bed

cues.speaker: lullaby-robert
cues.text: And softer than a shadow and quicker than flies

cues.speaker: lullaby-robert
cues.text: His arms are all around me and his tongue in my eyes

cues.speaker: lullaby-robert
cues.text: Be still be calm be quiet now my precious boy

cues.speaker: lullaby-robert
cues.text: Don't struggle like that or I will only love you more

cues.speaker: lullaby-robert
cues.text: For it's much too late to get away or turn on the light

cues.speaker: lullaby-robert
cues.text: The spiderman is having you for dinner tonight

cues.speaker: lullaby-robert
cues.text: And I feel like I'm being eaten

cues.speaker: lullaby-robert
cues.text: By a thousand million shivering furry holes

cues.speaker: lullaby-robert
cues.text: And I know that in the morning

cues.speaker: lullaby-robert
cues.text: I will wake up in the shivering cold

cues.speaker: lullaby-robert
cues.text: The spiderman is always hungry

cues.speaker: lullaby-robert
cues.text: Come into my parlour said the spider to the fly

cues.speaker: lullaby-robert
cues.text: I have a little something here
